questions.prompt: Which dynasty ruled China immediately before the Qing?
questions.fact: Its last emperor hanged himself on a hill overlooking the Forbidden City as rebels entered Beijing.

questions.prompt: Which process do bacteria use to reproduce?
questions.fact: Under ideal conditions some divide every twenty minutes, which is why food spoils so suddenly rather than gradually.

questions.prompt: In athletics, what is the standard height of a men's 110 metre hurdle?
questions.fact: The hurdles are weighted to tip forward if struck, a change made after athletes broke bones on rigid barriers.

questions.prompt: Which TV chef is associated with the phrase pukka?
questions.fact: The word is borrowed from Hindi, where it means properly made or genuine.

questions.prompt: Which UK city sits on the River Clyde?
questions.fact: At its shipbuilding peak the river produced roughly a fifth of all ships launched worldwide.

questions.prompt: Which novel features the fictional country of Gilead?
questions.fact: Its author began writing it in West Berlin in 1984, while the Wall was still standing.

questions.prompt: Which technology uses a distributed ledger with no central authority?
questions.fact: Its energy cost comes not from storing data but from making it expensive to rewrite history.
